verdicts.reason: A breaks the pink subhead and the 'It's time' line into two narrow side-by-side columns. The pink column is a ragged stack of one or two words per line that runs into the white text beside it, so the reading order is unclear. The white line is also oversized and competes with the headline, and the tiny body copy is jammed under it. B keeps a clean single column with the right hierarchy, but 'CANNOT' is left alone on its own line, the body copy is tiny, and the URL is crammed beside that body copy at the bottom instead of sitting in its own row.
